settings.title: Settings

auth.title: Caregiver Access
auth.hint: Enter the PIN to access system settings.
auth.pinError: Incorrect PIN. Please check with the responsible caregiver.

dwell.title: Dwell Timer
dwell.description: How long the gaze must rest on a button to activate it. Start with Normal; increase it if there are accidental clicks.

sound.title: System Audio
sound.description: Confirmation sounds, emergency alarm and synthesized voice.

voice.title: Custom Voice Cloning
voice.description: Upload an audio file (.wav) of the patient to create a personalized synthesized voice.
voice.lgpd: GDPR/LGPD: Voice is sensitive biometric data. The model will be stored exclusively for local assistive use by the patient.
voice.noProfile: Select a profile before cloning the voice.
voice.networkError: Could not upload the audio. Check the connection to the server.

backup.title: Settings Backup
backup.description: Saves every setting on this page to a file you can restore on another computer.

settings.subtitle: Tracking, display and patient follow-up settings.

eye.title: Dominant eye
eye.description: If one eye has more trouble moving, prioritize the other.

smoothing.title: Cursor smoothing
smoothing.description: Applies immediately. Stable removes tremor (reading); Responsive follows the gaze faster (keyboard and games).
smoothing.kalmanNote: These levels only apply to the One Euro filter. A comparison filter is active in this session, so the change is ignored.

advanced.title: Filter and cursor
advanced.description: Tracking engine options. They only take effect after the app is reloaded.

filter.label: Motion filter
filter.hint: One Euro is the production filter. Kalman and Kalman + EMA exist for comparison in measurement sessions.

cursorSize.label: Cursor size
cursorSize.hint: Diameter of the dot that follows the gaze.

ring.title: Progress ring on the cursor
ring.description: Draws the dwell progress around the cursor itself, in addition to the button.

blink.title: Blink to click
blink.description: A long blink confirms the button under the gaze. Off by default: blinking is involuntary.

scanning.title: Automatic scanning
scanning.description: After a few seconds without gaze, buttons are highlighted one by one for selection.

lost.title: Warn when gaze is lost
lost.description: Holds the cursor for 2 seconds, then asks to reposition the face.

pending.title: Changes waiting for reload
pending.body: The options above were saved, but the tracker only reads them at startup. The saved calibration is kept.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: The dark theme is easier on the eyes on large screens and reduces glare-induced blinking.

monitorBrightness.label: Monitor brightness (whole system)
monitorBrightness.hint: Dims the entire monitor. Depends on driver support.

comfort.title: Visual comfort
comfort.description: Lower the brightness and enable the amber filter if the patient blinks a lot or complains about glare.
comfort.amberHint: Reduces the blue component of light. Relieves light sensitivity.

geometry.title: Screen geometry
geometry.description: Used to compute the error in degrees and the position of the calibration points. Measure with a tape.
geometry.diagonalHint: Corner to corner of the visible area.
geometry.distanceHint: In the usual position of use. 50 to 70 cm works best.
geometry.defaultWarning: Default values in use. If the screen is not 23.6 inches at 60 cm, the error in degrees from the accuracy test will be wrong.

fov.title: Camera field of view
fov.calibrated: Calibrated: {{fov}}°. The distance meter in the setup screen is active.
fov.notCalibrated: Not calibrated: the app cannot estimate the distance on its own. Measure the distance from the face to the camera, enter it above, seat the patient in the usual position and click below.
fov.noFace: Face not detected. Sit facing the camera and try again.
fov.failed: Could not compute the field of view. Check the distance entered.

calibration.title: Calibration

state.title: Calibration status
state.description: The gaze model in use in this session.

calibration.recalibrateHint: Opens the setup and calibration screen. The current calibration stays valid until the new one finishes.

accuracy.title: Accuracy test
accuracy.description: Shows 13 points and measures the distance between the gaze and each one. Fill in the condition first; it becomes part of the report.
accuracy.needCalibration: Calibrate first to run the accuracy test.
accuracy.noSamples: Test without samples ({{missing}} of {{total}} points). Check the tracking and repeat.
accuracy.head: Head

reminders.title: Reminders and routine
reminders.description: Shown to the patient at the scheduled time.
reminders.missing: Fill in the activity and the time.

links.title: Dashboard and guide
links.description: Daily routine, symptom diary and the setup guide.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.body: The red button sounds an alarm on this computer, speaks out loud and, if a server is configured, sends a notice. It does not call anyone: keep a caregiver within earshot.

data.title: Data
data.consentOff: Consent removed. Local clinical data was deleted.

clinical.title: Clinical history
clinical.description: Accuracy over time, most used phrases and activity hours.
clinical.lgpdBody: Usage data, calibrations and phrases stay on this device only, for clinical follow-up. Nothing is sent to external servers.
clinical.consent: Allow local logging of the patient's routine and calibration
clinical.locked: Enable the authorization above to see the history.
clinical.trendHint: A mean error that rises over the weeks may indicate eye fatigue, a change in posture or disease progression. Recalibrate and check light and distance.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

live.title: Live readings
live.description: Updated twice a second. A dash means it has not been measured yet.

recorder.title: Session recorder
recorder.description: Records tracking data as text (no video) for analysis. Use it when support asks.
recorder.nothing: Nothing to export. Start a recording first.

diagnostics.pinNote: The caregiver PIN comes from the VITE_CAREGIVER_PIN variable (development value when unset). It must be replaced by server authentication before production use.

emergency.title: MEDICAL EMERGENCY
emergency.localAlarmDetail: Sound and screen calling anyone nearby, because of: {{label}}. This device does not send messages by itself.
emergency.escalatedDetail: Nobody turned the alarm off. The sound will keep going until someone cancels it.
